content.title: Functional Material Wordmark | Weave, Compress, Product Badge Activation
content.summary: Introduce a functional material before its wordmark, visibly interlace it into readable type, compress it into a badge and activate it on one product surface.

quick_start.input_format: The functional material appears before the word. + Two directional families visibly interlace. + The readable word preserves the same material topology. + The word compresses into a product-ready badge without a reset. + The badge lands on one final product surface and receives a small activation proof.
quick_start.recommended_input: Send thin cobalt ceramic ribbons into an ivory field from horizontal and vertical directions. Resolve the same braid into the exact original short word 'LINK' while loose ribbon carriers remain visible. Place the LINK badge on a charcoal travel case and activate one restrained blue indicator for the final proof.
required_anchors: The functional material appears before the word.
The word compresses into a product-ready badge without a reset.
The badge lands on one final product surface and receives a small activation proof.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Introduce a functional material before its wordmark, visibly interlace it into readable type, compress it into a badge and activate it on one product surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
